Meet Our Colorado Legal Team

Get The Legal Help You Need

Schedule a Consultation Now

Attorneys

Marie Drake

Marie grew up in Crested Butte, Colorado and also spent part of her childhood in Japan and the Philippines. She lived in Paris, France for 14 months during her junior year of college as well. After college at Pacific University in Oregon where she had a double major in Philosophy and French and was awarded Distinguished Senior in Humanities, Marie moved to New York City and attended law school at Fordham University.

Find Out More

Madeline LeGrange

Madeline LeGrange is an Associate Attorney at The Drake Law Firm, where she is dedicated to guiding clients through divorce proceedings and the complexities of family law with clarity, compassion, and a steady hand. Her practice encompasses a wide range of family law matters, including divorce, spousal maintenance, common law marriage, allocations of parental responsibility, parenting time and decision-making, child support, protection orders, paternity, and post-decree modifications. She also provides counsel on the negotiation and enforcement of prenuptial and postnuptial agreements.

Find Out More

Get The Legal Help You Need

Our experienced legal team is dedicated to serving communities with family law throughout Colorado and beyond. Whether you’re in Denver, Colorado Springs, or any of the surrounding communities, we’re here to provide the expert legal guidance you deserve. Contact us today to learn more about the areas we serve and how we can help with your legal needs.

Contact Us

Staff

Stephanie Berardini

Stephanie Berardini has been working for lawyers for nearly 30 years, starting in the file room of a downtown Denver law firm and then receiving her paralegal degree in 1996. Working with her husband, Brian J. Berardini, Esq., she developed her skills in high-pressure civil litigation, lender liability defense, family law, bankruptcy, foreclosures, probate, collections, evictions, and garnishments for individuals, small businesses, and national organizations.

Find Out More

Tatiana Quijano

Tatiana Quijano is the firm’s Scheduling Assistant and Happiness Coordinator. She handles client intake, client appointments, handles the attorneys’ schedules and creates reports that make everyone’s life easier. Tatiana has ten years of experience in Customer Service, Administrative Assistance, and Legal Assistance.
